item.title: Najib Barred From Politics, Media Appearances Under House Arrest
item.description: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak is barred from any political activities, media appearances and from receiving visitors without permission under his house arrest conditions, Home Affairs Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail said Thursday.
